sonnet.problem: The story card says the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites 'living there.' That nearly gives away the answer to card 14 (the Jebusites live among Judah's people). It also rules out the wrong answers 'The city lies empty and in ruins' and 'Judah's people have all moved away.'
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The question restates the same fact card 13 just told: Judah couldn't drive the Jebusites out of Jerusalem. It asks only whether the Jebusites are still there, so it re-asks that fact instead of asking something new.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
